author: Charles Pulliam-Moore
title: There are no good outcomes for the Warner Bros. sale
description: Netflix is the frontrunner to become Warner Bros.' new owner, but the war for control of the legacy studio isn't over just yet. Paramount Skydance has made its own outsize offer for the company that would give CEO David Ellison even more control over the news…
content: Netflix may be the frontrunner now, but the war for Warner Bros. could end in a number of different ways. by Charles Pulliam-MooreClose Charles Pulliam-Moore … [+8703 chars]
